hero.sub: Predict NBA, MLB, European football and BTC moves with USDT. Winners share the losing side's pool in proportion to their stakes; the platform is never your counterparty and only takes 5% of winners' profit.
hero.foot: Return rate = the share of all money staked that goes back to players. The Sports Lottery figure is the legal cap under Article 6 of Taiwan's Sports Lottery Issuance Act; Quick Come assumes stakes split evenly between both sides (about 99% if the favourite wins, about 96% if the underdog wins).

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Three steps. Money only moves between players.
how.s1p: Back "Lakers win" or "Warriors win", with any amount you choose.
how.s2p: When the result is in, the winning side shares all of the losing side's money in proportion to their stakes.
how.s3h: We only take 5% of winners' profit
how.s3p: The platform is never your counterparty and doesn't care who wins. If nobody backs the other side, everyone is refunded in full.
how.calc: Example: {win} USDT is staked on the Lakers and {lose} USDT on the Warriors, and the Lakers win. The losing {lose} is the winners' profit; the platform takes 5% = {fee}, and winners share {share}. You staked {stake} on the Lakers, so you get back {stake} + {share} × {stake} ÷ {win} = {payout} USDT. Of the whole {total} pool, {back} ({rate}) goes back to players.

dep.title: Deposit over BEP20 to save fees
dep.body: After launch you can deposit USDT on BEP20, TRC20 or ERC20. BEP20 has the lowest transfer fee; avoid TRC20 for small amounts, where the fee can eat up nearly 10%.
dep.short: After launch, deposit over BEP20 for the lowest fee; avoid TRC20 for small amounts.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Why aren't you the house? Where does the money come from?
faq.a1: Every game is a pool. Winners share the money staked by the losing side, not the platform's money. We don't care who wins; we only take 5% of winners' profit.
faq.q2: What if only one side has bets?
faq.a2: If nobody backs the other side, the game is cancelled and everyone is refunded in full, with no fee.
faq.a3: The minimum withdrawal is 100 USDT, and you need to verify your identity before your first withdrawal. You can keep your balance for future predictions.
faq.a4: Soon. Once the date is set, we'll send you a single email.
faq.q5: Will you keep sending me ads?
faq.a5: No. Apart from the confirmation email, we send one email at launch. Unsubscribe any time.

footer.risk: Risk warning: predictions can be lost, and a stake on the wrong option is not refunded. Only use money you can afford to lose.
